DushnikhYalCellar.name: Karsh-Naal Cellar
DushnikhYalCellar.why: the cellar under the longhouse (main quest 4 need: the longhouse and its cellar), where the guards keep their pay and stolen goods

plan.source: Ree-An-Wo (King of the Murkmire): a Naga camp in the marsh, its hide tents on two stilt watch towers and round a ground fire, bedrolls, cook stand, a Naga chest, a Xanmeer floor with busts, laid wholesale at one transform (turn 90, +290) with its marsh relief; the owner's ruling (2026-11-21) that main quest places get their closest match. The timber longhouse and its cellar the story needs are added whole from Dushnikh Yal, the one source holding them.

look.by: Ree-An-Wo's own six hide tents (four on the watch towers, two by the fire camp), a bone totem beside each ground tent
Dushnikh Yal's OrcLonghouse01 with its door and both rooms, added at the camp's east edge, its door facing the camp
the source's fire camp kept; a second fire of the source's own fire set before the longhouse door, where the guards keep

look.line: jars of sap stacked by the longhouse wall
look.by: three glazed urns by the wall south of the longhouse door, beside the quest's own stack

look.line: a cage at the camp's edge
look.by: Skyrim's MetalCage01 at the west edge toward the reeds, its door the quest's MetalCageDoor01
Curse of Cipactli's tall bone totem by the longhouse fire

gives.by: quest 4's guards at the longhouse fire and door, the camp's two guards on their patrol between the fires
the longhouse's store chest (copied with the room) behind its lock: the guards' pay and stolen goods; the Naga loot chest by the fire camp

structures.what: the fire camp, the low platform and the Xanmeer floor with its busts
structures.why: the camp's fire, tents, bedrolls, cook spot and its old stone heart; its gas traps dropped (a lived camp does not trap its own ground)

structures.what: the north watch tower with two hide tents
structures.why: the guards' watch point and sleeping platform over the marsh

structures.what: the second watch tower with two hide tents
structures.why: the record's hide tents; a second watch over the approach

structures.what: rock outcrops and cypress east of the camp
structures.why: the marsh's own ground; one rock before the longhouse door and a cypress inside it removed

structures.what: the cypress stockade scaffolds, ramps and scale fences (the tool reads stockade as a wall)
structures.why: they are the camp's watch towers, raised tent platforms and low fences, not a town wall; the record's danger (the cage reached unseen) holds: no fence rings the camp

structures.what: one plank walk (CypressStockadePlanks01, a mine-plank mesh)
structures.why: a plank walk off the low platform; nothing of a mine stands

factions.name: Karsh-Naal Camp
factions.law_why: no one keeps law: hostile, inhabited
